champion.tips: KOG'MAW TIPS AND TRICKS Farm up a storm during the early game and limit trading up until you have your first item. Then look to play hyper-aggressive once it is complete. Try and go for extended trades rather than short trades with the enemy as Kog’Maw can melt champions with the additional range and stats from his W . As Kog’Maw is very squishy and can easily die if he’s caught out, use Living Artillery R to check bushes instead of face checking them.
champion.builds: THE BEST KOG'MAW BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kog'Maw Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Bloodline and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Conditioning and Overgrowth in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Runaan's Hurricane, Terminus and finish with Jak'Sho, The Protean. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 53.0% winrate over 4 753 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cut Down with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Luden's Companion as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Shadowflame as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and Zhonya's Hourglass. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 53.6% win rate across 694 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kog'Maw Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Bloodline and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Conditioning with Overgrowth as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Guinsoo's Rageblade as third item. The last 3 options are Terminus, Jak'Sho, The Protean and Runaan's Hurricane. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.8% win rate over 128 matches played. Situational Kog'Maw Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kog'Maw build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kog'Maw runes page.
